articles.summary: ATLANTA, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Atlanticus Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: ATLC) (“Atlanticus,” the “Company,” “we,” “our” or “us”), a financial technology company that enables its bank, retail and healthcare partners to offer more inclusive financial services to millions of everyday Americans, today announced that Jeff Howard, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Bill McCamey, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in the B. Riley Securities Consumer TMT Conference in New York, NY on September 10, 2026. Information regarding the conference will also be available in the Events and Presentations section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.atlanticus.com .
